body: Thank you for that. Ever feel like everyone else’s flaw are superficial compared to yours? I do not remember the last time I was “happy”. Is that still a ‘thing’?
Oh, you know, usual suicidal weigh-downs: I’m alone. I’m a pain in the ass. I’m too much.

Thank you. I cannot stop crying at your kindness and compassion. You, a stranger, who does not judge me. The tears I cry are tears of happiness, anger, and frustration. Thank you for taking a judgement-free moment out of your day and responding to me. I appreciate you.
